title: Decision of the AI Office
summary: The document is a decision made by the AI Office, outlining its official stance or action on an AI-related issue. It likely details the Office’s determination, guidelines, or policies that will guide future AI practices within the organization.

title: AI Office Vacancy: Technology Specialists in AI
summary: This policy outlines the criteria and expectations for hiring technology specialists in AI to fill positions within the AI office. It details the required skills, responsibilities, ethical guidelines, and collaboration standards that these specialists must adhere to in order to support the organization’s AI initiatives.

title: AI Office Vacancy: Lead Scientific Adviser
summary: The policy announces the opening of a vacancy for a Lead Scientific Adviser in the AI Office. It outlines the role’s purpose to guide scientific strategy, ensure best practices, and support policy development in AI initiatives.

title: AI Office Vacancy: Legal Officers
summary: This policy explains how legal officers should handle open positions in AI-related roles. It sets out clear guidelines for fair hiring, proper documentation, and ensuring that all office vacancies meet regulatory and ethical standards.

title: AI Office Vacancy: Policy Officers
summary: The document announces a vacancy for a Policy Officer in the AI Office, outlining the key responsibilities of the role and the qualifications needed. It also explains the application process and what the organization expects from candidates who will help shape AI policy.

title: AI Act Scientific Panel
summary: The AI Act Scientific Panel is an advisory body created to support the EU AI Act’s implementation, offering expertise on the technical, ethical, and societal implications of AI systems. It aims to ensure AI is safe, transparent, and aligned with EU values while encouraging innovation.

title: Draft Standardisation Request
summary: The document is a draft request calling for the creation of standardized guidelines for artificial‑intelligence systems to ensure consistent safety, transparency, and regulatory compliance. It stresses the importance of industry collaboration and a coordinated regulatory framework to establish uniform standards across AI development and deployment.

title: CoP Consultation Notice
summary: The CoP Consultation Notice announces an upcoming consultation on a proposed Community of Practice framework. It invites stakeholders to provide feedback on its goals, structure, and implementation approach.

title: CoP Call for Expression of Interest
summary: This document announces a call for people to express interest in joining a Community of Practice (CoP). It invites individuals with shared interests or expertise to sign up, highlighting the purpose, potential benefits, and next steps for participation.

title: CoP Graphic: Overview of Iterative Drafting Process
summary: The document presents a graphic that outlines the iterative drafting process used by the Community of Practice for developing AI policy documents. It shows how drafts are created, reviewed, refined, and finalized through multiple feedback cycles to ensure thoroughness and clarity.

title: CoP Graphic: Timeline of Drafting Process
summary: This document presents a visual timeline that maps out the drafting process for the Community of Practice (CoP) policy. It highlights key milestones, dates, and steps taken during the development of the policy.

title: Code of Practice: 1st Draft
summary: This document sets out the first draft of guidelines for responsible AI use, outlining key principles such as transparency, fairness, and accountability. It aims to provide a foundational framework for organizations to adopt ethical AI practices and invites feedback to improve the standards.

title: Code of Practice: 2nd Draft
summary: The “Code of Practice: 2nd Draft” outlines guidelines for responsible AI development and deployment. It emphasizes key principles such as transparency, accountability, fairness, and safety to help organizations meet ethical and regulatory standards.

title: Code of Practice: 3rd Draft
summary: This document presents the third draft of a Code of Practice, outlining recommended standards and guidelines for responsible AI use. It serves as a framework to help organizations implement ethical, transparent, and safe AI systems.

title: AI Pact Draft
summary: The AI Pact Draft proposes a global framework for responsible AI development, stressing transparency, accountability, and alignment with human rights. It calls for international cooperation to manage risks while promoting innovation and societal benefit.

title: AI Pact Final
summary: The AI Pact Final is a comprehensive agreement that sets out the core principles and guidelines for developing and deploying artificial intelligence responsibly. It establishes collaborative frameworks, standards for transparency and safety, and commits participants to shared accountability and ongoing cooperation.

title: Guidelines on prohibited artificial intelligence (AI) practices
summary: This document outlines which types of artificial intelligence behaviors and applications are prohibited. It explains the reasons these practices are banned and offers guidance to help users stay within the allowed boundaries.

title: Guidelines on AI System Definition
summary: This document offers a set of guidelines to help people determine when a technology or tool should be considered an AI system. It outlines key characteristics, classification criteria, and practical steps for identifying and documenting AI components within various projects.

title: Communication on Boosting Start-Ups & Innovation
summary: This policy outlines how government communications will support the growth of start‑ups and foster innovation across the economy. It explains strategies to promote entrepreneurship, provide resources, and create a collaborative ecosystem that helps new businesses thrive.

title: EuroHPC Initiative for Start-Ups
summary: The EuroHPC Initiative for Start-Ups is a policy program that offers European new companies access to high‑performance computing resources, training, and funding to help them innovate and grow. It aims to boost the region’s competitiveness by connecting start‑ups with cutting‑edge HPC infrastructure and expertise.

title: Slideshow: Webinar on Risk Management
summary: This document outlines a webinar presentation on risk management, covering key concepts and best practices for identifying, evaluating, and mitigating potential risks. It provides an overview of risk assessment frameworks and offers guidance on developing effective risk management strategies.

title: Video: Webinar on Risk Management
summary: This webinar discusses strategies for identifying, assessing, and mitigating risks in AI systems. It also covers best practices for integrating risk management into AI development workflows.
